status: proposed contract; no participants registered and no real confirmation opened
scope: One evidence and registration contract with separate scorers for phonetic keys, rebus readings and meaning maps
preflight_scope: Reject missing, null, nonfinite, empty or unknown required declarations, changed source hashes, unreviewed exposure, unsupported rebus scorer, unfrozen participants and prior confirmation access. Human review must establish the truth of declarations and matched freedom across participants. Passing preflight never replaces the shots loader.
lexical_zero_policy: Zero exact occurrences means zero complete written-form matches in the specified token stream; it does not establish absence of the lemma, its inflected forms or its meaning.

required_participant_fields.comparison_group: The outcome and eligible population shared by the proposed reading and its controls
required_participant_fields.claim: Object with title, edition, locator, statement and sources (pinned artifact list); label any reconstructed claim
required_participant_fields.inputs: Nonempty pinned artifact list with repository-relative path and SHA256; associated source records give byte count, rights and transformations
required_participant_fields.sign_namespace: Object with name, version and crosswalk (pinned artifact list); ambiguous mappings remain sets
required_participant_fields.mapping: Pinned artifact list containing the complete submitted map, alternative values, unmapped signs and excluded records
required_participant_fields.construction_record: Objects, texts, dictionary pages, metadata and previous outcome families seen during construction
required_participant_fields.freedom: All choices listed in matched_freedom_fields, fixed before scoring
required_participant_fields.predictions: Named outcome, statistic family, direction, minimum independent units, null, pass rule and missingness rule
required_participant_fields.scorer: Versioned bench task and code hashes; rebus requires a separately reviewed task before acceptance
required_participant_fields.controls: Known-correct and wrong controls under the same source and freedom conditions
required_participant_fields.calibration: Accepted simulation plan and interval-based power/error report under stated laws
required_participant_fields.source_review: Accepted independent review and its pinned evidence
required_participant_fields.cohort: Reviewed-unexamined exposure, pinned identity and exposure reviews, and independent-unit count
required_participant_fields.freeze: Shared shots registration, joint credence rule, all artifact hashes and freeze before any confirmation read

object_register_interface.selection_status: Interface template only. No register version or prospective cohort is selected; the final reviewed version and its hashes enter each participant manifest.
object_register_interface.unknown_exposure_policy: Blocks a fresh claim. The current register's unreviewed state does not establish eligibility.
object_register_interface.evaluated_variables: Keep measurements and their source assertions separate from readings. Missing, conflicting and inferred values need frozen inclusion rules.

matched_freedom_fields: tuning objective, search budget and number of tries
comparison_rules: Group comparisons by outcome and population; do not rank different families by raw p-values.
Move full alternative lists together in fixed-key rearrangements.
Repeat any model or map fitting within each fitted null under the same discovery budget.
Evaluate a shared eligible population or preregister coverage-stratified contrasts when maps cover different signs.
Freeze all participants and the family-wise testing rule before the first confirmation read.
Report all prespecified predictions, including uncomputable ones and failures.
Repaired scores on already examined data remain retrospective. A new seed does not restore freshness.

phonetic_key.candidate: Complete published Sanskrit key with the final review repairs in paper 006
phonetic_key.positive_control: Known plaintext encoded at matched length, homophony and option-list freedom; also readable-script transfer when independent source data are available
phonetic_key.current_default_rule: p <= 0.01 and separation >= 3 SD overall and in both grouped halves; order-only p <= 0.01; unrelated language models must fail the same separation rule for a language-identification claim

rebus.candidate: Source-adjudicated Parpola identifications, with exact lexical lookup and reviewed variants
rebus.positive_control: A generated or independently attested rebus system with known assignments, dictionary coverage and compounds preserved
wrong_controls: whole-key replacements matched on declared lexical properties
wrong assignments with the same alternative-list sizes
an independently sourced rival-language dictionary under equivalent rules
rebus.blocking_reason: No calibrated shared rebus bench task; dictionary and identification gaps remain. A ratio above 1 or a small p-value alone is not an acceptance rule.

meaning_map.candidate: A fully frozen functional meaning map with independent object-variable predictions
meaning_map.positive_control: Known labels planted at prespecified effect sizes on a discovery-only incidence matrix, with shared outcomes within each object component
wrong_controls: label records rearranged within fixed frequency and position bands
meaning_map.current_default_rule: All measures computable; joint p <= 0.05; declared rank or leave-one-component-out influence criterion; individual predictions adjusted for multiplicity

next_calibration_campaign.status: proposed; thresholds require review before the campaign starts
next_calibration_campaign.planning_acceptance: 95% Wilson lower bound >= 0.80 for the declared minimally useful effect; for nominal 0.05 tests, null rejection rate <= 0.05 and 95% Wilson upper bound <= 0.065
laws: discovery-fitted wrong proposals with equal tuning budget
next_calibration_campaign.current_smoke_test_limit: One generated key example and 30 meaning-map power replicates do not certify this campaign.
